_about: Data for the Elm Landscaping supplier showcase (suppliers/elm-landscaping.html), read by supplier-preview-system/build-elm-landscaping-showcase.py. Facts restate Atlas (Products, catalogue source SRC-ATLPOP-20261016-010) and Elm's own pages. supplier.name: Elm Landscaping
supplier.countySource: Atlas ORG-000148: about-us page (Ennis, Co. Clare, established 2008) and the 065 landline.

publication.basis: Elm Landscaping YES, 2 Oct 2026 (by email; IPO-046). Rights record: image-rights-records.json (Elm Landscaping).
publication.objection: If Elm asks for any image to be changed or removed, delete its entry here, rebuild and release.
publication.commercial: No referral, commission or customer-benefit arrangement is agreed (a proposal of 22 Oct 2026 is unanswered). None is claimed, advertised or implied.

intro: An established Co. Clare landscaping company, working since 2008, that also supplies timber garden rooms and log cabins.
standfirst: Elm's own project photographs: paving, decking, stonework, water features and planting at finished Irish gardens. This is the groundwork a garden room sits in.

images.alt: A modern two-storey house above the sea, with a new gravel driveway, a lawn edged in stone and a terrace with a parasol.
